title: Dark Age
author: Pierce Brown
summary: Fifth in the Red Rising series. A young Republic is dragged into a brutal war across the planets, told from several viewpoints on different sides as the conflict gets personal.
readIf: you like relentless, high-stakes science fiction with huge battles and a cast that keeps being tested.
skipIf: you haven't read the earlier books, because this volume expects you to know the factions and their grudges.

pairings.reason: A thoughtful, bitter novel about soldiers fighting across vast distances, a calmer counterpoint to this one.
Similar multi-sided politics where nobody is safe and any alliance may break.
A grimmer, earthier look at war from inside the ranks, with a fantasy backdrop.
